name: Are there additional costs involved when selling a vacant house compared to an occupied one?

mainEntity.name: Are there additional costs involved when selling a vacant house compared to an occupied one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selling a vacant house can involve some unique costs not typically associated with occupied homes. These may include ongoing utility bills, property insurance (which can sometimes be higher for vacant properties), and increased expenses for property maintenance like landscaping to ensure curb appeal. Additionally, sellers might opt for professional staging services to make the empty space feel more inviting. It's crucial to budget for these continuous costs until the sale is complete, as they can impact your net proceeds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling a vacant house may incur additional costs like ongoing utilities, potentially higher insurance premiums, and property maintenance. Professional staging is another potential expense.
